List the publications in the database

Source: R/catalog.R
list_studies.Rd

List the publications in the database

Usage

list_studies(version = "latest")

Arguments

version

Release version, or "latest".

Value

A tibble with one row per study.

Examples

# \donttest{
list_studies()
#> # A tibble: 38 × 7
#>    study_id                           name  authors  year doi   journal citation
